status: reference implementation of the project methodology; not a production release

inputs.return_basis: daily simple cash-flow-adjusted time-weighted return (TWR), supplied by the upstream return service

annualization.rule: multiply the periodic statistic by sqrt(factor); the factor is fixed and never the user's observation count

risk_free.quote: historical daily-average annual yield to maturity of government Treasury bills
risk_free.conversion: rf_t = (1 + ytm_t) ** (1 / 250) - 1, one value per official session
risk_free.date_matching: exact session date; no forward fill, no zero fill, no current rate applied to the past

window_rule: official sessions in (as_of minus N calendar months, as_of]; the opening wealth point sits on the boundary

history.rule: one minimum per metric; no limited/standard quality tiers; counts come only from inside the selected window

downside.target: historical risk-free return of the same session
downside.denominator: all valid aligned observations (N), including those at or above the risk-free return
downside.shortfall_count: count(r_t < rf_t); equality is not a shortfall

recovery.event: maximum drawdown of the selected window
recovery.recovery_condition: first wealth point at or above the reference peak
recovery.search_end: window end, inclusive; data after the window is never used
recovery.tie_rule_status: open decision; ties are flagged with TIE_RULE_APPLIED
recovery.label_historical_window: not recovered by the end of this period
recovery.label_current_window: not recovered as of the latest data

weekly.weekly_return: prod(1 + r_t) - 1 over the week's valid sessions
weekly.weekly_rf: prod(1 + rf_t) - 1 over exactly the same sessions
weekly.week_start_status: example only; the official week definition is an open decision
weekly.partial_weeks: policy_pending; excluded from diagnostics and reported

extensions.note: Not part of the approved first-release metric set. Conventions follow the original research proposal and are documented as toolkit choices.

var.method: k worst returns, k = ceil(n * (1 - confidence)), no interpolation

beta.formula: cov(r - rf, m - rf) / var(m - rf)
beta.benchmark: total market index return, exact session alignment

open_decisions: official calendar source, cutoff and exact window boundary rule
risk-free source field, unit, effective dating, gaps and revisions
tie-breaking between equal maximum drawdowns and repeated troughs
capital-episode rules: total loss, full exit and re-funding
materiality rule for tiny but non-zero ratio denominators
quality thresholds for stale prices, runs of zero returns and extreme returns
official week definition, partial weeks and weekly minimum history
drawdown display sign and display precision
how a 12-month window meets a 250-observation ratio gate in a market with about 240 sessions a year
